approach: A QrController under /api/v1/links/{code}/qr resolves the link through LinkService (so status rules and the cache apply) and renders the short URL with a small QR encoder into a PNG.

alternativesConsidered.option: Render QR codes in the browser with JavaScript
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Printing and non-browser clients need a server-side image.

risks.mitigation: cap at 1024 px and rate-limit like redirects

rolloutPlan: Ship behind no flag: the endpoint is new and read-only; roll back by reverting the merge.
